title: BatchNFTMinter collapses multi-tx mint cadence into a single transaction, simultaneously amplifying L-04 runway depletion and concentrating the early-minter geometric APY premium
description: A single `batchMint(count=N)` produces `latestPrice * (1 + g)^N` and accumulates `mintDebt` for N mints atomically. This (a) accelerates NFTStaker runway depletion via the next `_recomputeSchedule` (prior-audit L-04 amplification — the multi-tx cadence assumption that operators may have implicitly relied on collapses to a single tx), and (b) lets a single first-batch caller capture the entire geometric APY premium pool (`r^N + r^(N-1) + ... + r^1`) before any organic minters can compete for the early slots. Without batching, each mint is a separate mempool event and competing minters can front-run each other for early slots.
impact: No principal loss path for honest stakers. The geometric APY premium ('earlier minters earn targetAPY * r^k') is documented intentional behavior (registered-projects.json L514, nft-staking-05 M-03-submission L130). Honest later stakers still earn the advertised `targetAPY` floor. The 'loss' relative to a hypothetical even arrival distribution that the spec never committed to is opportunity cost. The L-04 runway-acceleration angle is a re-statement of a prior-audit Low, but the new code path (batchMint) makes the worst-case acceleration achievable in a single tx instead of a coordinated multi-tx campaign.
attackPath: First user to interact with the freshly-deployed dispatcher calls batchMint(count=N) atomically
Dispatcher price compounds N times; first user captures r^N + r^(N-1) + ... + r^1 share of the early-minter premium pool in one tx
Subsequent organic minters pay higher latestPrice and earn exactly targetAPY (not the multiple)
[L-04 amplification] NFTStaker._recomputeSchedule next-fired sees a sharply higher latestPrice => higher rewardRate => shorter runway
recommendation: Cap `count` per `batchMint` invocation (e.g. MAX_BATCH = 10 or 32) so wholesale early-minter capture requires multiple separate transactions, restoring some of the front-running competition the original design assumed. Stronger fix: per-block / per-tx mint-rate limit at the NFTMinterV2 dispatcher layer that batched calls cannot bypass. Document the runway-stability implication in BatchNFTMinter NatSpec so operators can size top-up buffers accordingly.
severityRationale: DOWNGRADED from medium to low. The bulk of the framing restates documented intentional behavior (geometric APY-as-floor). The novel single-tx-capture angle does not cause value loss to honest stakers — they still receive their advertised targetAPY floor; what changes is the upper-bound earned by the first-mover, which is a design-disclosed parameter. The L-04 amplification angle is genuinely additive (the prior Low was framed as multi-tx; batching collapses this to one tx) but the underlying mechanism (runway shortens with latestPrice growth) is already an acknowledged Low. Operator-side runway-management documentation update belongs in the QA report. Not Medium because no honest-staker value leak materially exceeds what the spec already disclosed; not invalid because the L-04 amplification via a new code path is a legitimate re-flag.

scannerAttribution.dedupNotes: MERGED CODE-BNM-006 + ECON-005 + ECON-006. All three trace to the same enabler (atomic N mints in 1 tx). CODE-BNM-006 captured the L-04 runway-depletion angle; ECON-005 captured the early-minter premium concentration angle; ECON-006 captured the mintDebt-inflation angle (which ECON-006 itself concludes is only profitable 'when combined with ECON-005'). Merging produces a single cohesive mechanism finding with stronger framing on all three vectors. Same root mitigation (cap count or rate-limit at dispatcher) addresses all three.

sanitization.notes: PARTIAL OVERLAP with documented intentional behavior — flagged for human review but kept per 'when in doubt keep' policy. The geometric APY premium per se ('earlier minters earn targetAPY * r^k') IS a documented intentional design decision (registered-projects.json line 514; see also nft-staking-05 M-03-submission.md L130). The L-04 angle (latestPrice growth accelerating runway depletion) IS the documented prior-audit L-04 (nft-staking-07 qa-report.md L66-72) but is being AMPLIFIED here by a NEW code path (BatchNFTMinter.batchMint). Re-flagging an amplification of a prior Low via a newly-introduced contract is legitimate. The NOVEL claim — that batching collapses arrival-order competition and lets a single actor capture the entire premium pool atomically — is NOT documented. Per 'when unclear, keep' policy, KEPT but caller should be aware part of the framing restates known intentional behavior.

metadata.reclassificationReason: Bulk of framing restates documented intentional APY-as-floor behavior. Novel single-tx-capture angle does not cause honest-staker value leak. L-04 amplification via new code path is a legitimate Low re-flag.
